How Dynatrace pricing works
Pricing details

Your subscription includes our industry-leading capabilities and platform technologies like Davis AI, Grail, and Smartscape. Multi-year and volume-based discounts are available.

Application and Infrastructure Observability

End-to-end observability for applications and infrastructure. Extendable with Log Analytics, Digital Experience Monitoring, Code Monitoring, and Application Security. 

Choose Foundation or Infrastructure for infrastructure only, Full-Stack for both application and infrastructure observability.

Foundation & Discovery

Basic infrastructure monitoring and IT inventory.

$7 / mo
per host*
Basic host health indicators
Host and process topology detection
Filesystem monitoring (ex: disk usage)
OS services monitoring

*Billed at $0.01 per hour per host

Infrastructure Monitoring

Infrastructure observability for cloud, hyperscaler, and data center.

$29 / mo
per host*
Everything included in Foundation & Discovery
Process, disk, memory, and network analysis
Correlation of logs in context of hosts, cloud services, databases, network
Custom metrics for extensibility

*Billed at $0.04 per hour per host

Full-Stack Monitoring

Comprehensive observability for apps, microservices, and infrastructure.

$58 / mo
per 8 GiB host*
Everything included in Infrastructure Monitoring
APM
Automated root cause analysis for E2E transactions
Code-level profiling
Kubernetes Platform Monitoring
OpenTelemetry metrics and traces
10 days of trace data retention, extendable to 10 years

*Billed at $0.01 per memory-GiB-hour

View full rate card
View FAQs
Container Observability

Observability of cloud-native containerized environments, from infrastructure to application, down to the code level. Extendable with Real User Monitoring, Log Analytics, and Application Security.

Kubernetes Platform Monitoring

Visibility into Kubernetes clusters, nodes and workloads.

$1.40 / mo
per pod*
Kubernetes metrics and events: CPU, memory, network, and more
Health views and explorative analysis with data in context
Resources and topology
Included on hosts with Full-Stack Monitoring for no additional charge

*Billed at $0.002 per hour per pod

Code Monitoring

Troubleshoot and debug your code live in production instantly.

$3.60 / mo
per container*
Live code troubleshooting and debugging
Non-breaking breakpoints
Integration with Visual Studio Code and JetBrains

*Billed at $0.005 per hour per container

View full rate card
View FAQs
Log Analytics

Analyze logs in context and make smarter decisions when troubleshooting or measuring the health of your environments. Extendable with Application and Infrastructure Observability, Digital Experience Monitoring, and Application Security. 

Mix and match your logs pricing model across your environment, according to your use-case.

Pay only for the data you use.

Digital Experience Monitoring

Comprehensive monitoring for real user experience and synthetic testing across web, mobile, and API environments. Extendable with Application and Infrastructure Observability, Log Analytics, and Application Security for true end-to-end observability.

Choose Real User Monitoring or Real User Monitoring with Session Replay for all RUM features plus visual replay.

Real User Monitoring
Real User Monitoring

Gain full visibility into how end users experience every digital transaction across web, mobile, and single-page applications.

$2.25
per 1,000 sessions*
Capture and analysis of customer experience in every digital transaction
Mobile application monitoring and crash analysis
35 days of data retention

*Billed at $0.00225 per session

Real User Monitoring with Session Replay

Capture and visually replay the complete digital experience of end users to easily reproduce production issues and errors.

$4.50
per 1,000 sessions with replay capture*
Everything included in Real User Monitoring
Movie-like visual replay of end user experience
35 days of data retention

"Billed at $0.0045 per session with replay capture

Synthetic Monitoring
Browser monitor

Monitor business-critical workflows by simulating user visits.

$4.50
per 1,000 synthetic actions*
Web-based recorder
Scripted transactions
Private locations
35 days of data retention

*Billed at $0.0045 per synthetic action

HTTP monitor

Check availability and performance of internal and external resources—websites or API endpoints.

$1
per 1,000 synthetic requests*
Analytics tracking availability, response time, HTTP status codes
Global public and private synthetic locations
35 days of data retention

*Billed at $0.001 per synthetic request

Application Security

Immediate and continuous actionable insights across your complete environment. Security findings integrated in core observability apps and workflows.

Choose Runtime Vulnerability Analytics to surface critical exposures in your environment. Add Runtime Application Protection to block exploitation attempts.

Runtime Vulnerability Analytics

Detect and remediate critical 1st and 3rd party vulnerabilities at runtime.

$13 / mo
per 8 GiB host*
Detect 1st party code vulnerabilities and 3rd party vulnerabilities
Automatic prioritization by risk and impact
Ingest and analyze external security findings 

*Billed at $0.00225 per memory-GiB hour

Runtime Application Protection

Protect against and block exploitation attempts of your applications at runtime.

$13 / mo
per 8 GiB host*
Protects against top relevant OWASP security risks
Blocking of exploitation attempts
Covers 1st party code vulnerabilities

*Billed at $0.00225 per memory-GiB-hour

Security Posture Management

Stay compliant with key security guidelines and industry standards.

$5 / mo
per host*
Continuously identify and resolve misconfigurations
Detect and address security issues impacting your compliance at runtime
Evidence creation for auditing purposes
Covers compliance standards including CIS, NIST, DORA, HIPAA and more

*Billed at $0.007 per host-hour
